unresolved.name: Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital, Perambalur
unresolved.why: Perambalur has TWO Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan colleges in the NMC registry: 'Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan Medical College and Hospital,Perambalur' (Siruvachur, est. 2011, 250 seats, dsmedicalcollege.org) and 'Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan Institute of Medical Sciences and Hospital,' (Thuraiyur Road, est. 2023, 150 seats) — the latter is still unclaimed in nmcPool.
